# GanttScheduleMode

`Flare.Components.Gantt.GanttScheduleMode`

How a change to one item moves the items that depend on it.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `None` | `0` | Only the changed item moves. |
| `Push` | `1` | Successors whose constraint is broken are pushed later, keeping their duration. |

- `FlareGanttPanel`
